product_family: Mental health and wellness platform. Consumer app (Calm) with meditation, sleep stories, and mindfulness content; Calm Sleep (iOS-focused sleep app); Calm Health (clinical healthcare product with condition-specific programs); Calm for Team and Calm for Business (B2B offerings for employers and health plans).

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: Calm regularly commissions independent audits of its compliance with security policies as part of its SOC 2 Type II certification and will make summaries of its audit reports available to customers. Upon customer request, Calm will make available copies of, or extracts from, its audit reports related to security (for example, its SOC 2 report).

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: Calm Health is built to comply with HIPAA privacy and security standards. Calm will sign a business associate agreement for workplace and healthcare solutions delivered on a HIPAA-compliant platform.

certifications.name: HITRUST
certifications.proof_quote: Calm Health is built to comply with HITRUST and HIPAA privacy and security standards.

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: Calm's data processing is subject to the GDPR, Member State laws implementing the GDPR, and the UK GDPR. Calm uses Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) for EU data transfers and maintains a Data Processing Agreement available at https://www.calm.com/data-processing-agreement.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of direct ISO 27001 certification by Calm. Calm leverages AWS for cloud hosting, which is ISO 27001 compliant, but AWS compliance does not equate to Calm's own certification.

certifications.name: CSA STAR
certifications.proof_quote: Calm Health was listed in the CSA STAR Registry since 11/11/2024, indicating a Level 1 self-assessment submission with the Cloud Controls Matrix (CCM) questionnaire.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of PCI DSS certification. While Calm processes payments, no direct claim of PCI DSS certification was found in vendor materials.

privacy.ai_training_note: Calm uses Amazon Personalize to train machine learning models on customer behavior data including user choices, listening history, and purchase data. The system feeds behavioral data (which sessions users complete, stress levels, time of day, integrated wearable data like heart rate and sleep patterns) into third-party ML systems to generate personalized content recommendations. Users can withdraw consent for data usage. Calm also uses Amplitude for analytics. Note: This applies to behavioral/engagement data; separate health data privacy policies exist for Calm Health product.
privacy.data_region: AWS (us-east-1 and eu-west-1 inferred from Standard Contractual Clauses; no explicit data residency guarantee for EU users in public docs)

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: TLS encryption for data in transit

security.name: Encryption at rest
security.value: AWS KMS encryption for data at rest (vendor infrastructure)

security.name: Cloud hosting provider
security.value: Amazon Web Services (AWS), which is SOC 2, HIPAA, NIST, and ISO compliant

security.name: Facility security
security.value: AWS data centers maintain 24-hour security and controlled access to facilities

security.name: Staff training
security.value: Staff subject to contractual or statutory confidentiality obligations and regularly trained regarding privacy and security

security.name: Breach notification
security.value: Calm will notify customers of data breaches without undue delay and assist with GDPR notification obligations under Articles 33-34

security.name: Subprocessor management
security.value: Uses subprocessors including Amazon Web Services (hosting) and Amplitude (analytics). Customers can verify subprocessor list upon request.

products.name: Calm (Consumer)
products.data_scope: User behavior, listening history, sleep data, stress assessments, optional wearable data (heart rate, sleep), optional health data (with Calm Health integration)
products.notes: Paid subscription ($14.99/month or $69.99/year). Uses ML for personalized recommendations. Trains on customer engagement data. Covered by standard Privacy Policy and Data Processing Agreement.

products.name: Calm Sleep
products.data_scope: Sleep patterns, listening history, device data from Apple HealthKit
products.notes: Standalone iOS app launched September 2025. Features 500+ Sleep Stories. Integrates with Apple HealthKit.

products.name: Calm for Team
products.notes: For organizations with 5-100 employees. Tier-based pricing. Calm can sign BAA for HIPAA compliance when needed.

products.name: Calm for Business
products.data_scope: Employee and dependent usage data, health data (if employers are self-insured)
products.notes: For 100+ employee organizations. Custom enterprise pricing. Calm partners with 4000+ leading organizations. HIPAA-compliant with BAA; triggers business associate obligations for self-insured employers.

products.name: Calm Health
products.data_scope: Health information, vital signs (per health.calm.com/consumer-health-data-privacy-policy/), behavioral health data, wearable-derived health metrics
products.notes: Clinical-grade product for condition-specific programs. Available only through employer health plans or healthcare providers (not direct-to-consumer). Built to HIPAA and HITRUST standards. Separate privacy policies and consumer health data privacy policy apply.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium (7-day free trial). Subscription (consumer: $14.99/month or $69.99/year). B2B: per-user pricing (Team tier 5-100 employees), custom enterprise pricing (100+ employees). Calm Health: through health plan or employer sponsorship (not direct consumer pricing).
compare.data_residency: AWS-hosted. No explicit guarantee of EU data residency; uses Standard Contractual Clauses for GDPR compliance. EU Representative: eurep@calm.com.

flags: Calm actively trains on customer engagement and behavioral data using Amazon Personalize ML. This is disclosed in privacy policies, but users should be aware of it before selecting this platform.

HIPAA and HITRUST certifications are explicitly stated for the Calm Health product, not the consumer Calm app. B2B/Team offerings can add a HIPAA BAA upon request, creating three tiers of compliance posture. Confirm with the vendor which product the certifications apply to before relying on them.
There is no evidence of independent ISO 27001 certification; the vendor relies on AWS compliance. This is common for SaaS platforms but worth noting.

Calm does not maintain a dedicated trust center; compliance information is distributed across the Privacy Policy, DPA, and help center articles. This is acceptable but less transparent than enterprise vendors.

Standard Contractual Clauses are in place for GDPR, but there is no explicit commitment to EU data residency. Data is likely processed in the us-east-1 or eu-west-1 AWS regions; customers should verify directly with the vendor.
Third-party analytics via Amplitude could be a concern for users in regions with strict privacy laws. Review Calm's Amplitude configuration and its DPA with Amplitude before adopting the platform.

Calm Health collects sensitive health data (vital signs, symptoms, bodily functions). A separate Consumer Health Data Privacy Policy applies, with different deletion and consent rules than the main app.
